development_universe.selection_rule: liquid major USDT perpetuals selected before inspection of the family results; this is development, never the untouched asset holdout

execution_contract.reason: Phase A isolates entry information. Passive fills, profile targets, partials and break-even logic are not granted before the signal itself survives falsification.

cost_contract.fee_source: explicit conservative Binance USD-M regular-user taker baseline
cost_contract.note: The explicit fee prevents historical decision runs from drifting with future CCXT/exchange-default fee metadata. Account-specific VIP discounts are upside and must not be assumed in V0.

candidate_hypotheses.AuctionExpansionV0: A first close outside a completed price channel has stronger 60-minute conditional expectancy when the same candle has unusually strong same-direction reported public-trade flow.
candidate_hypotheses.RetestContinuationV0: Conditioning an already confirmed breakout on a one-bar retest/reclaim plus supportive public-trade flow improves conditional expectancy relative to immediate expansion entries.
candidate_hypotheses.FailedAuctionReversionV0: An excursion beyond a completed channel that closes back inside has short-horizon reversion expectancy even without a directional flow filter.
candidate_hypotheses.AbsorptionReversalV0: Extreme reported public-trade flow that fails to hold a channel excursion adds information beyond the price-only failed-auction condition.

phase_a.purpose: measure entry information before exit engineering

quant_finance_pipeline: freeze strategy source, manifest, pairlist, timerange, data snapshot, explicit fee contract and Freqtrade image
download and validate 1m/5m OHLCV plus raw public trades for every frozen pair
run Freqtrade recursive-analysis when compatible with the beta orderflow path
run full-period viability backtest with exported trades and explicit fee
run fixed-parameter chronological validation windows without hyperopt
report aggregate and per-asset performance, long/short split, turnover and time-in-market
stress additional execution friction above the explicit fee baseline
freeze candidate before untouched asset/regime holdout
run portfolio marginal-admission gate against actual incumbent account returns
only then permit immutable forward/test-lane epoch and Probe review
falsification: flow-conditioned candidate does not improve its structural price-only control out of sample
result is not better than a matched randomized null
declared fees plus plausible additional friction erase the edge
effect depends on a single asset, direction or chronological window
candidate constants are changed after decision data is inspected without a new trial identity
orderflow features cannot be reproduced from the frozen raw-trade snapshot
